columns.name: CfWorkspaceId
columns.description: The ContraForce workspace the event belongs to.

columns.name: Discriminator
columns.description: The audit domain, e.g. WorkspaceManagement or IncidentInvestigation.

columns.name: ActivityType
columns.description: The activity type name, e.g. WorkspaceRoleChanged.

columns.name: ActivityAction
columns.description: The activity action name, e.g. Update.

columns.name: ActorId
columns.description: The id of the user or agent that performed the activity.

columns.name: ActorName
columns.description: The display name of the actor, when recorded.

columns.name: ActorEmail
columns.description: The email of the actor, when recorded.

columns.name: TargetResourceType
columns.description: The type of the resource the activity targeted, e.g. Incident or User.

columns.name: TargetResourceId
columns.description: The id of the resource the activity targeted.

columns.name: TargetResourceName
columns.description: The human-readable name of the target resource, when recorded.

columns.name: Metadata
columns.description: Activity-specific metadata as a JSON string including its $type discriminator; parse with parse_json in queries.
